Don't just rewatch it. Re-enter it.

Spatial Capture on Insta360 X6 records an object or a space in 360, then turns it into a 3D model you can move through in the app. Not a video you watch from one seat, but a place you can walk back into, look around, and revisit from any angle.

Every memory, exactly where you left it.

Insta360 X6 launches August 12.
